title: Navigating Exascale Operational Data Analytics: From Inundation to Insight
problem: HPC facilities generate multi-terabytes of operational data daily from heavily instrumented supercomputers, creating a massive data management challenge. Existing approaches lack a coherent end-to-end strategy for transforming this data inundation into actionable operational insights across the full HPC lifecycle.
motivation: Sustainable data-driven efficiency in HPC operations requires effective strategies for managing and analyzing massive operational data streams across procurement, operations, and R&D phases.
method: The framework ingests and processes multi-terabyte data streams generated daily by supercomputers at Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility, handling the entire pipeline from raw data collection through analysis. The researchers built and refined this system across two generations of hardware, documenting the design decisions, challenges encountered, and pipeline strategies that actually worked. By learning from the first generation and improving the second, they created a systematic approach to turning massive data volumes into useful operational insights.
key_novelty: A two-generation evolution of an operational data analytics system at Oak Ridge that shows how to transform daily multi-terabyte data streams from supercomputers into actionable operational insights.
contributions: End-to-end operational data analytics framework evolved and validated across two generations of supercomputer systems
Identification of key obstacles and design decisions critical to building sustainable HPC data pipelines
Comprehensive data lifecycle analysis spanning procurement, operations, and R&D phases
Community recommendations for enabling sustainable operational data analytics and operational intelligence in HPC

metrics.other: Data ingestion rate (multi-terabytes per day), pipeline sustainability

baselines: Prior generation OLCF operational data infrastructure
limitations: Specific quantitative performance metrics, comparative analysis against alternative approaches, and scalability limits are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: Operational intelligence for exascale HPC systems
